import importlib.util, json, math
from fractions import Fraction as F
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
p=Path(r"D:\workspace\AGI的哲学思考\research_cognition_physics\archive_1086_\1091\check.py")
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("author1091",p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
I=np.eye(2,dtype=complex); X=np.array([[0,1],[1,0]],complex)
Y=np.array([[0,-1j],[1j,0]],complex); Z=np.diag([1.,-1.])
P=(I+Y)/2
gate=np.kron(P,X)+np.kron(I-P,I)
K=math.pi/2*(np.eye(4)-gate)
HC=.1*np.kron(Z,I)
ket=np.kron(np.array([1.,1.])/math.sqrt(2),np.array([1.,0.]))
D=np.kron(I,np.diag([0.,1.]))
def free(t):
    phase=np.diag(np.exp(-1j*.1*t*np.array([1.,-1.])))
    return np.kron(phase,I)
def rk4(delta,n):
    h=2/n; U=np.eye(4,dtype=complex)
    def f(q,V): return -1j*(delta*HC+.75*(1-q*q)*K)@V
    for j in range(n):
        q=-1+j*h
        a=f(q,U); b=f(q+h/2,U+h*a/2)
        c=f(q+h/2,U+h*b/2); d=f(q+h,U+h*c)
        U=U+h*(a+2*b+2*c+d)/6
    return U
rows=[]
for v in (0.,1.):
    s=2-v; tc=1/s; delta=.001/s; T=1.25
    UU=[]
    for n in (4096,8192):
        UU.append(free(T-tc-delta)@rk4(delta,n)@free(tc-delta))
    prob=float(np.vdot(UU[-1]@ket,D@(UU[-1]@ket)).real)
    author=m.clock_gate((0.,2.,1.,v),T,1024)
    ideal=(1+math.sin(.2*tc))/2
    row={"v":v,"independent_probability":prob,
         "rk_refinement_norm":float(np.linalg.norm(UU[1]-UU[0],2)),
         "unitarity_residual":float(np.linalg.norm(UU[-1].conj().T@UU[-1]-np.eye(4),2)),
         "author_operator_difference":float(np.linalg.norm(UU[-1]-author,2)),
         "actual_vs_centre_probability_difference":abs(prob-ideal),
         "analytic_contact_probability_bound":.4*delta,
         "author_midpoint_operator_bound":3*math.pi/(2*1024)}
    assert row["rk_refinement_norm"]<1e-10
    assert row["unitarity_residual"]<1e-10
    assert row["author_operator_difference"]<row["author_midpoint_operator_bound"]
    assert row["actual_vs_centre_probability_difference"]<row["analytic_contact_probability_bound"]
    rows.append(row)
rng=np.random.default_rng(701091)
res=0.
for j in range(12):
    x=rng.normal(size=(4,3)); v=rng.normal(size=(4,3))
    u=rng.normal(size=3); t=float(rng.uniform(.1,3))
    left=x+v*t-u*t; right=x+(v-u)*t
    res=max(res,float(np.max(np.abs(left-right))))
    for a in range(4):
        for b in range(a):
            res=max(res,float(np.max(np.abs(((x[a]+v[a]*t)-(x[b]+v[b]*t))-((right[a])-(right[b]))))))
assert res<1e-12
future=[]
for c0 in (1e-6,.001,.1,1.,2.,10.,100.):
    T=1.; eps=.001; u=c0/2; w=max(3*c0,10*eps/T)
    gamma=1/math.sqrt(1-(u/c0)**2)
    receive_time=T+eps/w; L=w*T
    dtp=gamma*(receive_time-u*L/c0**2)
    assert dtp<0
    future.append({"c":c0,"u":u,"w":w,"T":T,"epsilon":eps,
                   "receive_complete_time":receive_time,
                   "Lorentz_complete_receive_time_difference":dtp})

mismatch_lower=F(23,20)*F(499,1000)*F(999,1000)
